fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Fixed text "MAKAIMURA"; if it does not match at power-on the game writes it and wipes all progress and records
fields.evidence: appears at first power-on; code 4000:093b compares with ROM 4000:c970, mismatch -> 4000:053f wipe

fields.name: practice_active
fields.meaning: 1 while a stage is played from the LIBRARY practice mode; the real progress below is then restored on return
fields.evidence: code d000:112a sets, d000:1153 clears and restores; read d000:11ba at boot

fields.name: practice_backup_area
fields.meaning: Area number held aside during LIBRARY practice (valid 0..17)
fields.evidence: code d000:112a writes, d000:1153 restores, 4000:053f range-checks at boot

fields.name: practice_backup_map
fields.meaning: Map number held aside during LIBRARY practice (copied back to the current map)

fields.name: practice_backup_section
fields.meaning: Map section held aside during LIBRARY practice (copied back to the current section)

fields.name: current_map
fields.meaning: Current stage map number (0x0A for the first stage of a new game; higher values for later maps)
fields.evidence: 0x00->0x0A when a new game starts; code 4000:05be, 4000:6be3..; readers branch on it (a000:a00f/a09a)

fields.name: current_section
fields.meaning: Section within the current map (reset to 0 at each map start)
fields.evidence: code 4000:05be, 4000:6b90..6da8 writers

fields.name: option_level
fields.meaning: OPTION LEVEL: 0 EASY, 1 NORMAL (default), 2 HARD
fields.evidence: 1->2 when the menu is set to HARD (shown on screen); code 4000:1279 draws EASY/NORMAL/HARD from it

fields.name: option_players
fields.meaning: OPTION PLAYER: lives at the start of a game (default 3); the game starts with this minus 1 in reserve
fields.evidence: 3->4 when the menu is set to 4 (shown on screen); code 4000:07ab default 3, 4000:05be lives = value-1

fields.name: option_buttons
fields.meaning: OPTION BUTTON CONFIG: 0 = jump A / shot B, 1 = swapped
fields.evidence: 0->1 when swapped in the menu; code 4000:06f6 picks the jump/shot button masks from it

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Cleared when the save is created; no reader found
fields.evidence: code 4000:07ab clears

fields.name: checkpoint_weapon
fields.meaning: Weapon Arthur holds at the last checkpoint (low byte 0..7; 6 is the weapon needed for the true final area)
fields.evidence: code 4000:e422 copies from RAM 1a1e, 4000:053f loads back (>7 -> 0), 4000:e2e9 tests 1a1e==6; always 0 in this play

fields.name: checkpoint_area
fields.meaning: Area reached at the last checkpoint (0..17); CONTINUE restarts here
fields.evidence: code 4000:e422 / 9000:1194 / d000:1194 copy from RAM 1b74; 4000:053f and d000:11ba load it; boot read 4000:055d; verified CONTINUE resumes a stage

fields.name: score_resume_flag
fields.meaning: 1 = set when an area starts, 0 = cleared when a life is lost; when 1 the checkpoint score is restored too
fields.evidence: 1->0 on losing a life, 0->1 at the next area start; code 4000:6b78 sets, 4000:83fe and 4000:8ca5 clear, d000:11ba tests

fields.name: checkpoint_score
fields.meaning: Score at the last checkpoint (0..9999 in the stored unit)
fields.evidence: code 4000:e422 / d000:1194 copy from RAM 1e90, d000:11ba loads it, 4000:e45b zeroes it on game over; always 0 in this play

fields.name: checkpoint_lives
fields.meaning: Lives in reserve at the last checkpoint (0..8)
fields.evidence: 2->3 when OPTION PLAYER 3->4; 0->2 at game over; code 4000:e422 copies from RAM 1e2a, 4000:0653 loads (>8 -> PLAYER-1), 4000:1279 refreshes from OPTION

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Tail of the monster-book area cleared at creation (entries 42-43), never written otherwise
fields.evidence: code 4000:075f clears 44 entries; writers limited to n < 42; zero in every save

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Padding between the item table and the hit counter; an entry 22 here would overlap the hit counter
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: times_hit
fields.meaning: Times Arthur was hit (not shown in the LIBRARY)
fields.evidence: code 4000:84e2 (+1 on every hit); +1 on each observed hit; value 66 = 2 x 33 deaths

fields.name: deaths
fields.meaning: Arthur record: deaths
fields.evidence: screen shows 33; +1 on death; code 4000:83fe / 4000:8ca5

fields.name: jumps
fields.meaning: Arthur record: jumps
fields.evidence: screen shows 156; grows on jump presses; code 4000:a06d

fields.name: crouches
fields.meaning: Arthur record: crouches
fields.evidence: screen shows 1; +1 on crouch; code 4000:7f57

fields.name: ladder_climbs
fields.meaning: Arthur record: ladder climbs
fields.evidence: screen shows 0 (list order); code 4000:7f71

fields.name: walks
fields.meaning: Arthur record: times walked
fields.evidence: screen shows 77; code 4000:86e5

fields.name: armor_lost_count
fields.meaning: Arthur record: times reduced to underwear (armour lost)
fields.evidence: screen shows 33; +1 when hit in armored form; code 4000:84e2

fields.name: underwear_time
fields.meaning: Arthur record: total time in underwear (seconds, minutes, hours)
fields.evidence: screen shows 00h02m with bytes 2B 02 00; copied from the running timer when leaving the game; code d000:0fab

fields.name: baby_count
fields.meaning: Arthur record: times turned into a baby
fields.evidence: screen order (value 0); debug fill 4000:3efe order

fields.name: baby_time
fields.meaning: Arthur record: time as a baby (s,m,h)
fields.evidence: code d000:0fab copies from the running timer

fields.name: old_man_count
fields.meaning: Arthur record: times turned into an old man
fields.evidence: screen order (value 0)

fields.name: old_man_time
fields.meaning: Arthur record: time as an old man (s,m,h)
fields.evidence: code d000:0fab copies from the running timer

fields.name: woman_count
fields.meaning: Arthur record: times turned into a woman
fields.evidence: screen order (value 0)

fields.name: woman_time
fields.meaning: Arthur record: time as a woman (s,m,h), counted in place
fields.evidence: code 4000:b0a4 (form 2 ticks it directly)

fields.name: tips_unlocked
fields.meaning: TIPS book: one byte per tip, 1 = unlocked
fields.evidence: code d000:0fab unpacks the bits of 0x022A-0x0230 into these bytes (49 bits; 022C bits 1,5 skipped; tip 49 set directly only); 4000:5283 sets one directly

fields.name: play_time_s
fields.meaning: System record: total play time seconds
fields.evidence: screen shows 00h09m with bytes 1E 09; copied from the running timer; code d000:0fab

fields.name: play_time_m
fields.meaning: System record: total play time minutes
fields.evidence: screen; code d000:0fab

fields.name: play_time_h
fields.meaning: System record: play time hours (shown capped at 99h59m)
fields.evidence: code d000:0fab (cap 99 / 59); value 0 here

fields.name: new_game_count
fields.meaning: System record: NEW GAME count; 0 means no game was ever started and CONTINUE acts as NEW GAME
fields.evidence: screen shows 1; +1 at NEW GAME; code 4000:0f3f (+1), 4000:0e7e tests

fields.name: high_score
fields.meaning: System record: HI-SCORE (best score, stored 0..9999, shown times 100: "000000")
fields.evidence: screen shows 000000; code 4000:e66b and d000:0fab keep the maximum of the score; 4000:40d9 appends "00" for display

fields.name: continue_count
fields.meaning: System record: CONTINUE count (menu CONTINUE and continue after game over)
fields.evidence: screen shows 10; +1 on CONTINUE; code 4000:0e7e / 4000:0f09

fields.name: stage_best_times
fields.meaning: System record: fastest clear time per stage, 8 entries of (minutes, seconds): STAGE1, STAGE2, STAGE3A, STAGE3B, STAGE4, STAGE5, then two more rows
fields.evidence: screen page 2 (all 00:00, no stage cleared); code 4000:40d9 items 6..13 read, 4000:b56f writes on stage clear if faster

fields.name: tip_counter_a
fields.meaning: Hidden counter; at 10 it unlocks a tip

fields.name: tip_counter_b
fields.meaning: Hidden counter; at 100 it unlocks a tip (also logs item book entry 20)

fields.name: zone_counters
fields.meaning: One counter per area group; grows while jumping inside that group's zone, resets outside; at 10 a tip for that area unlocks
fields.evidence: code 4000:a06d increments through a pointer table and sets 0x022A/0x022B bits at 10; 7 counters match the 7 area groups

fields.name: hit_this_area
fields.meaning: 1 once Arthur was hit in this area (a flag, reset at each area start)
fields.evidence: 0->1 on a hit, 1->0 at area start; code 4000:84e2 sets, 4000:6996 clears, 4000:b680 tests for the no-hit tip

fields.name: true_final_reached
fields.meaning: 1 after the last boss is beaten holding weapon 6 (sent to the true final area)
fields.evidence: code 4000:e2e9

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: no_weapon_change
fields.meaning: 1 until Arthur's weapon changes; gates two tip bits
fields.evidence: 0->1 at NEW GAME; code 4000:05be sets, 4000:b7bf clears on weapon change, 4000:b796 tests

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: game_start_counter
fields.meaning: Count of game starts (NEW GAME + CONTINUE); at 250 a tip unlocks
fields.evidence: +1 on NEW GAME and on CONTINUE (value 11 = 1 new game + 10 continues); code 6000:cc0d

fields.name: old_man_timer
fields.meaning: Running time as an old man (s,m,h), copied to the record on leaving the game
fields.evidence: code 4000:b0a4 (form 4), d000:0fab

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: baby_timer
fields.meaning: Running time as a baby (s,m,h), copied to the record
fields.evidence: code 4000:b0a4 (form 3), d000:0fab

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: underwear_timer
fields.meaning: Running time in underwear (s,m,h), copied to the record
fields.evidence: 0x2B copied to the record on leaving the game; +2 over two ticks; code 4000:b0a4 (form 1), d000:0fab

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: play_timer_s
fields.meaning: Running play time seconds; advances by 2 per tick (a quirk: the code increments it twice)
fields.evidence: +2 per tick observed twice; copied to the record; code 4000:b0a4, disasm 4000:b0d8/b0dd

fields.name: play_timer_m
fields.meaning: Running play time minutes, copied to the record
fields.evidence: minute rollover observed; code 4000:b0a4, d000:0fab

fields.name: play_timer_h
fields.meaning: Running play time hours, copied to the record
fields.evidence: code 4000:b0a4 (low byte rolls into the high byte at 0xFF), d000:0fab copies the word

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: tip_counter_c
fields.meaning: Hidden counter; at 10 it unlocks a tip
fields.evidence: code 6000:cc25

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: No writer found
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: tip_counters_d
fields.meaning: Six hidden counters (one per kind of event); at 30 each unlocks a tip

fields.name: tips_pending_bits
fields.meaning: Tips earned during play, one bit each; turned into the TIPS flags when leaving the game
fields.evidence: code 4000:a06d, 4000:b0a4/b680/b796, 6000:c7xx set bits; d000:0fab unpacks (disasm: 022A-022B full, 022C bits 0,2,3,4,6,7, 022D-022F full, 0230 bits 0-2)

fields.name: owner_name
fields.meaning: Copy of the console owner's name from the handheld's own settings memory
fields.evidence: byte-identical to the console settings ("WONDERSWAN" here); appears at first power-on; code 4000:08f2

fields.name: owner_profile
fields.meaning: Copy of the console owner's birthday and profile from the handheld's settings
fields.evidence: code 4000:08f2 writes 0x023D-0x0242 (all 0 here, as in the console settings)

fields.name: game_clear_state
fields.meaning: Set when the last boss is beaten: 1 = sent to the start / true final area, 2 = sent back to area 15
fields.evidence: code 4000:e2e9; cleared at NEW GAME 4000:05be; always 0 here

fields.name: stage_record_mask
fields.meaning: One bit per stage whose clear time is still to be recorded in this run; FF at NEW GAME
fields.evidence: 0->FF at NEW GAME; code 4000:05be sets, 4000:e361 tests it and records the time then saves

fields.name: sprite_text_count
fields.meaning: Work buffer: number of sprites drawing the current on-screen text
fields.evidence: 9 at the game-over screen; code d000:1279 builds it from ROM

fields.name: sprite_text_list
fields.meaning: Work buffer: the text sprites, 4 bytes each (tile, attributes, y, x); not progress
fields.evidence: filled at game over; x steps +8 per sprite (a text line)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Wiped at creation; never written otherwise
fields.evidence: zero in every save

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written (zero in every save)
fields.evidence: all saves checked

fields.name: console_owner_name
fields.meaning: Handheld settings (owner name); the game only reads it, never writes it
fields.evidence: console memory identical with and without the save; game copies it to SRAM 0x0231
